title: 36 Hours in Tulum, Mexico
abstract: A yoga aesthetic and stunning cuisine prevails on this beachfront town, located on the southern edge of Mexico’s Riviera Maya.

title: 36 Hours in Warsaw
abstract: In the five years since Poland ascended to the European Union, a colorful injection of money and culture has given the city an unmistakable glow.

title: 36 Hours in Oslo
abstract: With tree-lined promenades and sidewalk cafes, the charms of a summer stroll in this pricey city will melt away the sticker shock.

title: 36 Hours in Juneau, Alaska
abstract: Gold Rush-era buildings, quality regional theater and fresh seafood make for pleasant companions to this capital city’s stunning surroundings.
